subject: C6h: c6gc analysis + fixes (bridge LOAD snapshot, code cache, failure sites)
body: Ranked (evidence c6gc xnu-live.log): (1) bridge legacy LOAD path snapshotted the whole target per draw: 104x 'NORD2 GPU MAP bytes=11239424' = alloc+map+SYNC+11 MB memcpy+release per LOAD draw on the imported display; FIXED: preload samples the target in place unless the draw has feedback (framebuffer fetch / target bound as texture), same per-tile read-before-writeback as Mesa pre-frame preload. (2) KERNEL (not mine): src/nord2_gpu_core.c:765-776 cleans every page of every mapped BO in the context before each job phase, and job_finish (368-376) invalidates every GPU-writable BO of the context after each job: cost scales with all mapped memory (3 display surfaces 33.7 MB + snapshots) per job; observed ~31 ms/job (1.88 s / 61 jobs). Proposed kernel change: limit maintenance to the job's handle list (bridge submits complete lists). (3) PSO: 83 unique misses, 53.7 s AIR translation on the render thread (68 distinct fixed_frag constant sets, ~650 ms each); pack=refused (build-tag mismatch), disk cache cold per build -> ship a PipelinePack generated from the device misses.txt for the exact build. (4) per-draw shader-code upload (VS/FS, up to ~0.8 MB) FIXED: content-compared LRU code BO cache (8 MB, pinned for the current draw). (5) one synchronous submit+WAIT per job, no JM batching (structural). (6) shadow refresh 1.7 MB/command (small). Correctness (1)/repeats: 16 command failures (bridge 0xE00002C2, kind=draw load=1 imported display) not reproducible on host (textured fixed_frag + imported 1125x2436 LOAD passes). TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED now prints site=<bridge line>/<n2r line> for the exact check; the removed snapshot path (alloc/SYNC/memcpy of imported BO) was on this path. Frame repeats: (a) most likely: CA still swaps after a failed command buffer, so the double-buffered surface shows content from 2 frames earlier plus partially executed jobs -> old frames reappear; fixing the BAD removes it. (b) late kernel copy (<=100 ms, no retention) can show NEWER partially rendered content if SwapWait returns before the copy, not older; 0085 retention prevents use-after-free only. (c) coherence: job_finish invalidates GPU-written BOs before present reads; shadows (small sampled surfaces) refreshed per command: no stale-frame path found. Gates: iOS -Werror x3 + bridge + render OK; run_host_tests all PASS (new bridge test: in-place LOAD, code cache) except NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN probe; integration 1005 checks, only the unrevised CA natural-stride oracle fails; render harness PASS; CA test 35 PASS ASan+release, pending 0.
